title: Chess, But SCP-173 Is Coming For You
summary: Standard chess vs Stockfish with neutral, uncapturable SCP-173 (the sculpture) on a4. Whenever no piece of either side 'watches' it (attacks its square), it makes one knight jump toward the nearest king, capturing whatever it lands on ('lawnmowering'). If any piece has line of sight on it, it is frozen. It jumps to b2 heading for White's king, the c1 bishop freezes it; narrator later releases it so it hops c4-d6 into Black's camp, wins the queen and finishes with a promotion ladder mate.
rules: Standard chess otherwise; player White vs Stockfish (3600).
Neutral SCP-173 starts on a4; cannot be captured.

After each move [timing: appears per ply/turn], if NO piece of either colour attacks SCP-173's square, it makes one knight move toward the nearest king (by knight-distance), capturing any piece on the landing square.
If at least one piece (either side) attacks its square, it cannot move.
If it lands on a king, that king is captured and that side loses [inferred].
win_condition: Checkmate Stockfish (promotion ladder mate in video) or have SCP-173 take the black king.
